'''Lewis Cowart''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dagobah Regionals]] on 29 July 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|ROPs]], according to Clay Cushman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1074">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-01-dagobah-regional-7-29-00d1074/ dagobah-regional-7-29-00], DeckTech (, 1 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-01-dagobah-regional-7-29-00d1074/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
